facts.fact: MISA Zambia says the Access to Information Act No. 24 of 2023 is enacted and, with SI 56 of 2025, now operational.
facts.system: Access to Information Act No. 24 of 2023

facts.fact: MISA Zambia says SI No. 56 of 2025, setting request procedures, timelines and forms, was signed on 20 August 2025 and gazetted on 29 August 2025.
